group back_head {

  point bottom_inner = coordinate(x: 54.707016125042976, y: bottom_outer.y)

  point dart_lower_base = coordinate(x: 21.89741483639077, y: -126.91341376457413)
  point dart_upper_base = coordinate(x: 31.218545444066194, y: -117.1738427636081)
  point top_closed_bake = coordinate(x: 28.671342284460664, y: -105.31726559625525)

  const dart_close_angle: number =
    angle(tip, dart_lower_base) - angle(tip, dart_upper_base)
  point top = polar(
    from: tip,
    angle: angle(tip, top_closed_bake) - dart_close_angle,
    distance: distance(tip, top_closed_bake),
  )
  curve center = bezier(
    start: top,
    end: bottom_inner,
    startAngle: 290.91933103458837,
    startLength: 11.709949737441427,
    endAngle: 263.916841373784,
    endLength: 13.907927154795209,
  )
  line bottom = segment(start: bottom_outer, end: bottom_inner)

  group seam {
    line center = offset(
      sources: [back_head::center],
      distance: 7,
      side: @left,
    )
    line bottom = offset(
      sources: [back_head::bottom],
      distance: 7,
      side: @right,
    )
    edge [
      back_head::seam::center.end,
      back_head::seam::bottom.end
    ](index: 0)
  }

  point opening_lower = onLine(
    from: center.end,
    distance: 5,
    steps: [distance: 1],
  )
  point opening_upper = onLine(
    from: center.end,
    distance: 33,
    steps: [distance: 1],
  )

  group notch {
    instance upper = notchLib::convex_notch(
      line: back_head::center,
      base: back_head::opening_upper,
      distance: 12,
      trimLine: back_head::seam::center,
      curveSide: @convex,
    )
    instance lower = notchLib::convex_notch(
      line: back_head::center,
      base: back_head::opening_lower,
      distance: 12,
      trimLine: back_head::seam::center,
      curveSide: @convex,
    )
  }
}
